tools.name: calculate_fire_target
tools.description: Estimate the savings target needed for Financial Independence / Early Retirement. Runs Monte Carlo simulation and returns the probability the portfolio survives the planning horizon.

tools.name: calculate_coast_fire
tools.description: Compute the Coast FIRE milestone — the capital required today such that, with no further contributions, a portfolio compounds to the user's retirement target by their target age.

tools.name: compute_swiss_property_tax

tools.name: get_portfolio_returns
tools.description: Return RetireCrunch's historical portfolio return profiles for a currency. Each profile is a (return %, volatility %) pair derived from real index data — useful for grounding the assumptions in calculate_fire_target / project_wealth_plan in something defensible rather than guessing.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_rebalance_plan" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_rebalance_plan · Private data: load_portfolio · Public sink: get_rebalance_plan · Destructive: project_wealth_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_rebalance_plan · Private data: load_portfolio · Public sink: get_rebalance_plan · Destructive: project_wealth_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
